info.title: EnterpriseX ERP API
info.description: POST creates orders. PO: PENDING_APPROVAL -> APPROVED -> PARTIALLY_RECEIVED -> COMPLETED; rejection only while pending. SO: CONFIRMED -> RESERVED -> FULFILLED -> INVOICED. Invoice: ISSUED -> PARTIALLY_PAID -> PAID. Atomic workflows include inventory and accounting; failures roll back all business mutations. All monetary amounts are USD.
